title: AEW operator notification
description: M4-E plan v3 §2.8 and E7 (operator decision 1); amendment 1, E7a: the JSON object the operator endpoint writes, one per occurrence, to the notifier's stdin. Plan v3's {event, project_id, subject, reason, ref, revision, at}, plus `source` (where the endpoint learned it: control state, the broker's liveness record, or a spool writer), `authenticated` (true only for an event derived from control state; a liveness record and a spool line are local files a same-uid process can forge, so they only ever notify), and an optional `reason_code` (filled from M4-E E8b on). The event enum is §2.8's whole table; E7a delivers generation_ended, broker_gone, raise_requested, confirmation_requested, breaker_tripped, custodian_lost, hard_deadline and launch_failed, and the later slices the rest. A notification is attention, never authority: nothing reads it to act.
